reviews.title: HORRIBLE! WHYD YOU UPDATE IT?!
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app because i was struggling with my History class, and needed help. I downloaded this app and immediately got 100% on my assignment. I do online school, so get grades back immediately, and honestly it was so helpful! I would recommend this to anybody reading this! Its very helpful!

 Edit: I changed my review to four stars because its still a good app but there are some clear major issues regarding the recent updates. The ai used to be FLAWLESS, and was improving, but with the recent updates, I don't know what happened. The issue is that the ai seems as if it DOWNGRADED when the app updated. Multiple choice questions specifically is what it seems to be struggling with. As of today I have been trying to get the ai to answer a multiple choice question, however instead of replying to my question it gives me a random fact of information on a close topic, but this topic did not generally have anything to do with my question. I tried multiple times, I rewrote the problem, scanned it again, but its answer wouldn't change. This app has potential, that's why I only took away one star, however right now without further changes to be made on improving the ai, hopefully in the multiple choice category, it's not going to be getting many downloads, and that wouldn't be great because as I stated, there's potential, it just needs some fixes towards the ai.

edit: one star. since when do i need to subscribe for more scans? that is ridiculous! i loved this app originally, and it was a great and helpful tool that i thought was going places, however, now i cant even scan my questions without having to subscribe?! that is ridiculous. You ruined the app. one star
